# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| >= 0.2  | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.2   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability or potential threat in `aur-sentry`, please report it responsibly:

1. **GitHub Security Advisory**: Use the [Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/rebizzz/aur-sentry/security/advisories/new) feature on GitHub.
2. Provide a detailed summary, steps to reproduce, and any proof-of-concept.
3. We will respond within 24 hours and issue fixes or security advisories promptly.

Please do not open public issues for undisclosed security vulnerabilities.
